relationships.subject: CGRP
relationships.evidence_quote: Spontaneous pain behavior and mechanical and thermal hyperalgesia after PSNL were not different between αCGRP knockout mice and WT mice throughout the observation period.

key_findings: αCGRP knockout did not alter spontaneous pain or mechanical/thermal hyperalgesia after partial sciatic nerve ligation.
Dorsal horn CGRP immunoreactivity did not differ between PSNL and sham at 1 and 7 days.
